Find the inner products (i) TikAk. (ii) TikAkBi. (b) Let Tijk and Rijk be tensors of rank 3. Using the transformation rule (i.e., formal definition) [9 marks] of a tensor, show that TipjRijq is a rank 2 tensor. Solutions based on number of free indices will not be accepted. Use the formal definition, i.e. the transformation rule. (c) Let A be a 3 × 3 matrix over R. Use suffix notation to show that if A has two identical rows, [8 marks] then its determinant |A| is zero. Here, you must demonstrate this fact using suffix notation. General linear algebra arguments will not be accepted Answers: (ai)   3 −1 6   . (aii) 5 (b) No numerical solution. Question 2 [25 marks] In this question, denote by K the Cartesian coordinate system with vector basis i1, i2, i3, the standard orthonormal basis of R3. Denote by K ′ the coordinate system with vector basis e1, e2, e3 given by e1 = 3i1 + i2 + i3 e2 = i2 e3 = 2i1 + i3. (a) Find the basis e 1, e 2, e 3 dual to e1, e2, e3. [9 marks] (b) (i) Find the covariant components of the vector V = i1 + i2 − 2i3 with respect to the basis e1, [3 marks] e2, e3. (ii) Find the contravariant components of the vector V = i1 + i2 − 2i3 with respect to the basis [3 marks] e1, e2, e3. (c) (i) Find the components of the rotation matrix L = (L j i′). [4 marks] (ii) Express the covariant components of the second-order tensor of K with components [6 marks] [Pik] = [P ik] = [P ·k i ] = [P i ·k] =   1 0 0 0 2 −1 0 0 3   in the coordinate system K ′. Do not forget to show your workings and justify your answers. Answers: (a) e 1 = ( 1 0 −2 ) , e 2 = ( −1 1 2 ) , e 3 = ( −1 0 3 ) . (bi) V1 = 2, V2 = 1, V3 = 0. (bii) V 1 = 5, V 2 = −4, V 3 = −7. (ci) L =   3 1 1 0 1 0 2 0 1  . (cii)   13 2 8 1 2 −1 9 0 7   . Academic year 2024/25 Page 2 of 4

# Page 3^page=3
Question 3 [25 marks] (a) Let Bik be a second-rank tensor with Bik ̸= 0 for all i, k ∈ {1, 2, 3}. We define a quantity Aijk by Aijk = ϵijℓBkℓ. The quantity Aijk is a third-rank tensor (but you do not need to show this). Check the symmetry property of Aijk with respect to the following indices. Specifically, deter- mine whether Aijk is symmetric, antisymmetric, or neither with respect to the following indices. (i) The first and second indices, [4 marks] (ii) The first and the last indices. [4 marks] (b) Let a, b, c, and d be vectors in R3. Using suffix notation, find an expression involving no cross [9 marks] products for (a × (b × c)) · ((a · c) d) . Write your final answer in vector notation and provide all steps of your workings. (c) Let r = (x1, x2, x3) denote the position vector in a coordinate system in R3. Define r = |r| and [8 marks] let f be a scalar field. Recall that ∇ denotes the gradient operator. Show that ∇f (r) = f ′(r) r r . [Hint: Recall that f ′(r) = ∂f ∂r . ] Answers: (ai) Aijk is antisymmetric with respect to the first two indices. (aii) Aijk is neither symmetric not antisymmetric with respect to the first and last indices. (b) (a · c) 2(b · d) − (a · b)(a · c)(c · d). (c) No numerical solution. Question 4 [25 marks] In this question, consider the three-dimensional orthogonal coordinate system (x1, x 2, x 3) = (ρ, ϕ, θ) with position r given by r = eρ cos ϕ cos θi1 + eρ sin ϕ cos θi2 + eρ sin θi3, where i1, i2, i3 are the usual Cartesian basis vectors. (a) Compute the basis vectors e1, e2, e3 of this coordinate system. [9 marks] (b) (i) Compute the metric tensor gik of this coordinate system. [6 marks] (ii) Describe the arc length element in terms of the metric coefficients. [2 marks] (c) Determine the following Christoffel symbols of the first kind for the given coordinate system: [8 marks] Γ111, Γ122, Γ223, Γ233. Answers: (a) e1 = eρ cos ϕ cos θi1 + eρ sin ϕ cos θi2 + eρ sin θi3, e2 = −eρ sin ϕ cos θi1 + eρ cos ϕ cos θi2, e3 = −eρ cos ϕ sin θi1 − eρ sin ϕ sin θi2 + eρ cos θ. (bi) gij = 0 if i ̸= j and g11 = e2ρ, g22 = e2ρ cos2 θ, g33 = e2ρ, gij = 0 whenever i ̸= j. (bii) (ds) 2 = (eρdρ) 2 + (ρ cos θdϕ) 2 + (eρdθ)2 and h1 = eρ, h2 = eρ cos θ, h3 = e ρ. (c) Γ111 = 2e2ρ, Γ122 = 2e2ρ cos2 θ, Γ223 = −2e2ρ cos θ sin θ, Γ233 = 0. Academic year 2024/25 Page 4 of 4
